newsitem.title: UK: BPB Industries appoints deputy chairman.
newsitem.headline: BPB Industries appoints deputy chairman.

text.p: UK building supplies group BPB Industries Plc said on Tuesday it had appointed Allan Gormly as deputy chairman, with immediate effect.
Gormly, 58 is currently non-executive deputy chairman of Royal & Sun Alliance Insurance Group and a former joint deputy chairman of Trafalgar House, BPB said.

He was appointed to the BPB board as a non-executive director in January 1995 and is presently a member of the management remuneration and development committee and chairman of the nomination committee, it added.
"Alan Turner, who will be 63 in November, continues as chairman of BPB, an appointment he has held since 1985," the group said in a statement.
